payload.text: Golden-oracle gate (FX forward PV reference): fx_forward_pv is a pure closed-form function of (side, spot, strike, notional, t, r_dom, r_for) — side*notional*(spot*e^{-r_for t} - strike*e^{-r_dom t}), dual-discounted, no writes, no I/O, deterministic. The FX-forward reference PV the parity suite pins must depend solely on its inputs.
